authors: Codex continuation; frozen by the main research session
question: Does the source-bound signed norm-branch coefficient tensor exhibit a growing held-out flattening-rank defect large enough to admit the preregistered SAT/proof-size stage?

claims.text: Direct signed group sums, direct evaluation-matrix singularity, Laplace coefficients, product-kernel block ranks, and reconstructed bounded norm witnesses agree at the declared finite scope.
Global and fixed-cardinality flattening ranks are exact over each named field and split; a full-rank pivot modulo p also certifies full rank of the canonical integer lift over Q.
The experiment does not establish a branch finder, SAT speedup, ECDLP speedup, security claim, universal hardness result, or novelty claim.

hypotheses.statement: Natural curve-derived tensors have a growing low-rank balanced separator absent from support-matched independent coefficients.
hypotheses.mechanism: Fixed-cardinality blocks are compound-Vandermonde product kernels; a growing defect could reduce exact separator-message state before any SAT encoding.

predictions.minimum_effect: on the split minimizing natural rank (ties by smallest left mask), natural rank at most one half of the null rank on that same split at k=12 and k=14 for every prime/seed pair; matched-null minus natural log2-rank slope at least 0.125 per added Boolean variable

data_seen.measured: fixed d=5 rank-one block only; no growing or natural census

arms.description: Prime-order curve-derived target/support points with exact Laplace coefficients.
Independent nonzero field coefficients on the byte-identical two-level support.
Independent nonzero ordinate multipliers; exact fixed-cardinality rank-invariance control, not a null.
A second distinct arithmetic-progression abscissa family with identical dimensions.
Synthetic nonzero outer product whose exact rank is one.

comparisons.threshold: rank ratio <= 1/2 and slope gap >= 0.125 for advance; exact full-rank equality for strict measured-family kill
identical ordered model sets and complete norm/group replay
zero disagreements, with every producer pivot minor independently extracted from its recorded row/column indices and its determinant recomputed

controls.aa_not_applicable: No timing endpoint. Deterministic regeneration is the A/A analogue and must be byte-stable.

confounders: target ordinate coupling between adjacent levels

randomization.arm_order: fixed within a single deterministic producer invocation
randomization.arm_order_reason: No timing comparison; natural source generation precedes derived controls.

seed_derivation.note: All null/control streams are domain separated in source.

instance_sampling.rule: One maximum k=14 target/support draw per prime/seed, with frozen prefixes for smaller k.

blinding.how: Exact structural arms are identifiable; thresholds and held-out sizes are frozen before invocation.

power.note: No population p-value; every frozen held-out cell must satisfy the directional gate.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: static operation-count estimate only; no scientific timing claim

primary.name: Exact global coefficient-flattening rank
primary.definition: Rank over the named prime field for one balanced split.

primary.name: Exact fixed-cardinality product-kernel block rank
primary.definition: Rank from both raw Laplace coefficients and the scaled product kernel.

secondary.name: Signed target decompositions
secondary.definition: Exact number among all 2^k branch assignments.

secondary.name: Native exact arithmetic counters
secondary.definition: Field additions, multiplications, inversions and comparisons in producer coefficient/rank paths.

checkpoint.restore_validation: fresh identical retry only after definite infrastructure failure

stopping_rules.rule: One producer and one checker invocation, then stop.
Stop on budget uncertainty/exhaustion, source or protocol mismatch, capacity refusal, output cap, deadline, nonzero producer/checker exit, or mutation/control failure.
Do not run SAT B2 unless ADVANCE_B2 fires.

invalidation_rules: Any semantic, rewrite, mutation, independent-checker, or rank-one positive-control failure makes the scientific verdict inconclusive.
A modular defect cannot be called a Q defect without fraction-free replay or an explicit integer null vector.
An infrastructure failure is not a mathematical negative and does not authorize changed seeds, thresholds, resources, or backend.
A successful pod without matching source/image/job/payload receipts is incomplete.

decision_rule.text: ADVANCE_B2 only on the universal held-out half-rank and 0.125 slope-gap gate plus a checked product-kernel defect whose target inclusion is unchanged, exactly one side cardinality grows by one, available rank does not shrink, and deficiency does not decrease. KILL_MEASURED_FAMILY only when every held-out global and fixed-cardinality rank is full and each global rank matches its null. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact paired ranks and log2 rank slopes.
decision_rule.interval: none; all frozen held-out cells required
decision_rule.multiple_comparison_correction: universal conjunction over the frozen split search; no selected partition inference
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: natural/null rank ratio and paired log2-rank slope difference

reporting.review_schema: experiment.review/v1 when canonical checker becomes available
graphs: Natural and matched-null minimum global rank by k; block-defect and semantic-control flow diagram.

inadmissible: Calling one singular minor a tensor or SAT breakthrough.
Treating randomized ordinates as an independent null for fixed-cardinality ranks.
A speed, ECDLP, security, novelty, exhaustive-search, or universal-hardness claim.
Changing held-out sizes, seeds, split count, thresholds, or controls after artifact generation.

literature.claim: Prime-field composed-map factor bases and open relation-system complexity.
Prime-field summation-polynomial relation collection and one-basis variant.
Borchardt determinant-permanent identity for inverse-square Cauchy matrices.

freeze.note: Exact protocol bytes are bound by the companion digest and pushed source revision supplied to the producer and EKS request. Canonical external schema checker unavailable; existing repository v1 examples were used without inventing a successful validation receipt.
